digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation system with relationship pins and execution-phase enforcement
propositions: Plan-review attestations currently remain valid after related tickets change their plans, allowing assumptions to diverge from actual dependencies
New plan reviews must sign cryptographic pins binding each direct child and prerequisite to its current material fingerprint and canonical ID with role
Pin validity is checked at read time during claim, close, re-review, and audit; drift invalidates attestations only when enforce_plan_material_pins is enabled
The plan_review_phase reducer projection carries planning or execution state, where execution-phase reviews apply a fixed 0.80 priority floor and require compatible downstream blocking criteria
Close operations must verify a current certified plan review when require_plan_review_for_close is enabled, checking pin drift and phase compatibility but not file freshness

Prerequisite consistency is evaluated deterministically with per-target coverage records that carry disposition (consistent/finding/indeterminate) and attributed findings, never altering the signature
